name: Customer Balance Detail
description: Provides access to the Customer Balance Detail report from the QuickBooks Online Report Service.

parameters.name: customer
parameters.description: Filters report contents to include information for specified customers. Supported Values: One or more comma separated customer IDs as returned in the attribute, Customer.Id, of the Customer object response code.

parameters.name: shipvia
parameters.description: Filter by the shipping method as stored in Invoice.ShipMethodRef.Name. Supported Values: Any shipping method as sent in the Invoice.ShipMethodRef.Name attribute at Invoice create- or update-time.

parameters.name: term
parameters.description: Filters report contents based on term or terms supplied. Supported Values: One or more comma separated term IDs as returned in the attribute, Term.Id of the Term object response code.

parameters.name: end_duedate
parameters.description: The range of dates over which receivables are due, in the format YYYY-MM-DD. start_duedate must be less than end_duedate. If not specified, all data is returned.

parameters.name: start_duedate
parameters.description: The range of dates over which receivables are due, in the format YYYY-MM-DD. start_duedate must be less than end_duedate. If not specified, all data is returned.

parameters.name: custom1
parameters.description: Filter by the specified custom field as defined by the CustomField attribute in transaction entities where supported. Supported Values: Name of custom field.

parameters.name: sort_by
parameters.description: The column type used in sorting report rows. Specify a column type as defined with the columns query parameter.

parameters.name: report_date
parameters.description: Start date to use for the report, in the format YYYY-MM-DD.

parameters.name: sort_order
parameters.description: The sort order. Supported Values: ascend, descend

parameters.name: aging_method
parameters.description: The date upon which aging is determined. Supported Values: Report_Date, Current

parameters.name: department
parameters.description: Filters report contents to include information for specified departments if so configured in the company file. Supported Values: One or more comma separated department IDs as returned in the attribute, Department.Id of the Department object response code.

parameters.name: columns
parameters.description: Column types to be shown in the report. Supported Values: bill_addr, create_by, create_date, cust_bill_email, cust_comp_name, cust_msg, cust_phone_other, cust_tel, cust_name, deliv_addr, doc_num*, due_date*, last_mod_by, last_mod_date, memo*, sale_sent_state, ship_addr, ship_date, ship_via, term_name, tracking_num, tx_date*, txn_type* Additional columns with custom fields enabled: sales_cust1, sales_cust2, sales_cust3 Additional columns with location tracking enabled: dept_name*
